text:
aj: Starting rollout for release v2026-03-20-42 -> chart redwood-model-frontend 3.3.0 (previously 3.2.0). Canary at 5% now.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started (5%). Tracking pods: model-proxy x3, frontend x2.

infra-bot: Reminder: change window 02:00-06:00 UTC.

maria: Seeing elevated 502s from model-proxy in canary. Samples show `invalid kv-cache header` on /infer.

maria: logs snippet: `2026-03-20T02:12:11Z model-proxy error: upstream returned 502, invalid kv-cache header, connection id=abc123`

raj: Looks like chart bumped model-proxy image to v1.4.0 which added a required header field. Not backwards compatible.

aj: Pause further traffic. set canary=0%.

deploy-bot: Canary paused by @aj. Current canary pods: 2/3 ready, 1 crashloop. Health checks failing.

infra-bot: Two options: (A) helm rollback to previous revision (chart 3.2.0) OR (B) patch values to pin `image.tag=v1.3.2` for model-proxy and reapply. Rollback will revert other unrelated chart deps.

sara: Prefer minimal blast radius — pin the image for now. We need to preserve any bugfixes in 3.3.0 that aren't related.

raj: I'll push an override and run a targeted upgrade:
```
helm upgrade --install redwood-model ./charts/model \
  --namespace production \
  -f override-canary-pin.yaml \
  --set modelProxy.image.tag=v1.3.2 \
  --timeout 10m
```
raj: override-canary-pin.yaml contains: `modelProxy:\n  image:\n    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent` (just the pin).

aj: Add a release note line: "Reverted model-proxy to v1.3.2 in canary due to header contract change in v1.4.0; follow-up to align headers and runtime behavior."

maria: After the upgrade, run smoke: `curl -vS -X POST https://prod/model/infer -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`

deploy-bot: Applied override at 1772509923. Helm status: deployed. New pods initializing.

maria: Pods now Ready=3/3, smoke test returns 200 and expected JSON.

aj: Good. Keep rollout paused until we validate metrics for 15m and run canary traffic ramp tests.

raj: I'll open a hotfix PR `hotfix/chart-proxy-pin-3.3.0` with pinned values and a changelog entry. Also add an entry to the release notes and escalate to eng-runtime to sync header contract.

sara: Also note in calendar: follow-up sync w/ runtime + proxy owners tomorrow to avoid recurrence.

aj: Postmortem owners: @raj (lead) and @maria (investigation). Tag: eng-runtime, eng-releases.

raj: Creating PR and linking to this thread. :thumbsup:
